task.title: Consolidate agent workflow surface and automate session boundaries
task.summary: Prioritize a smaller direct agent workflow surface that removes deprecated aliases/catalogs and makes new_session/context_refresh boundaries agent-owned instead of user-command driven.

goal.outcome: CodeWiki exposes a smaller direct workflow surface and required session/context boundaries are handled by the agent/adapter without asking the user to paste or press Enter on internal compatibility commands.
acceptance: `codewiki_claim` is not registered and callers use `codewiki_artifact_status` directly.
Static application tool catalog source is removed; the skill-facing catalog remains the documented tool map.
Deleted alias/catalog files are absent from package smoke and active docs.
Artifact-status coordination tests cover mark/read-overlap/conflict/release without the claim alias.
Active system docs and roadmap no longer instruct preserving wrapper aliases as the migration policy.
Session-boundary flow does not present /wiki-session-handoff or equivalent compatibility commands as normal user work for required boundaries.
Where Pi/adapter APIs can execute a boundary automatically, CodeWiki does so from agent-owned control flow and restarts from CodeWiki refs.

Where host APIs cannot execute a boundary from tool context, CodeWiki records an explicit platform limitation/fallback with next safe action instead of asking the user to press Enter as a routine step.
Workflow-efficiency evidence records user-interrupt/manual-command impact for the session-boundary path and keeps validation/task-close/publication proof gates intact.
Focused smoke tests cover automatic/no-user-command behavior and unsupported fallback semantics.
non_goals: Do not remove real application use-case services that still orchestrate IO, mutation, rebuild, or validation.
Do not refactor `src/application/claims.ts` into domain in this slice; keep runtime coordination behavior stable while removing the public alias.
Do not reopen TASK-006 role-worktree/publisher proof semantics except where session-boundary UX/tool surface needs stale-reference cleanup.
Do not implement full decision_build compiler in this task.
Do not weaken fresh-context/content-proof requirements for validation, task-close, publication, publish, or release.
Do not promise true new terminal/tab/process creation when Pi does not expose it; use explicit external-orchestrator/worker fallback language when needed.
Do not make completion-report generation the primary deliverable; keep it as follow-on unless small integration is needed for efficiency evidence.
verification: Run tests/smoke/session-handoff.test.mjs and related claim/wait smoke tests.
Run CodeWiki audits: alignment, changed, stale-reference, file-structure, generated-parity.
Validate implementation from fresh CodeWiki refs with checked content proof.

loop_start.reason: Compiler loops start from CodeWiki source refs; agents may refresh context when chat is noisy, stale, or token-heavy.

validation.reason: Implementation validation must not reuse builder thought context and must cite checked content proof.

next_loop.reason: The next gateway must independently validate implementation evidence and cite checked content proof.

requirements.text: Policy-required new_session/context_refresh boundaries should be executed by the agent/adapter automatically when host capabilities allow, without asking the user to paste or press Enter on a command.
If host limitations prevent automatic session creation/reset, CodeWiki must record a precise platform block/fallback instead of presenting the compatibility command as normal user work.
Workflow efficiency must be a roadmap success criterion measured by fewer user interrupts, fewer manual commands, shorter closure path, clear finish reports, and bounded loop/session/write cost.
Session automation and workflow-friction reduction take priority over TASK-001 decision_build implementation until the next roadmap alignment says otherwise.

summary: Implement TASK-005 agent-owned session boundary behavior and no-user-command fallback semantics.

evidence: TDD used tests/smoke/session-handoff.test.mjs to lock new behavior: tool-context new-session yields platform-limited fallback with no command; context-refresh calls compact automatically; workflow_efficiency reports zero user interrupts/manual commands; command-context compatibility still works.
Regression checks keep claim/wait and package smoke stable, preserving existing artifact-status and internal command registration behavior.
notes: Targeted session-handoff smoke passed before broader checks.
No tests required true terminal-tab creation because non-goal says do not promise unsupported Pi terminal/process spawning.
tester.boundary: derive tests or test-design evidence before code changes where practical

evidence: src/application/tools/session-handoff.ts adds workflow_efficiency evidence, automatic tool-context compaction for context-refresh/context-reset, and platform-limited new-session fallback without surfacing /wiki-session-handoff.
src/adapters/pi/tools/session-handoff.ts removes editor prefill/command hint surfacing and updates prompt guidance to distinguish automatic compaction from platform-limited new-session.
src/adapters/pi/schemas.ts updates autoQueue description to state automatic supported boundaries and platform-limited fallback.
skills/codewiki/SKILL.md and skills/codewiki/references/tool-catalog.md update workflow instructions/catalog semantics.

notes: Implementation intentionally leaves command-context /wiki-session-handoff registered as an internal compatibility executor for hosts that have command context; it is no longer surfaced as routine user work from the tool path.
Implementation does not change validation/task-close/publication proof gates.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: Session-boundary flow does not present /wiki-session-handoff or equivalent compatibility commands as normal user work for required boundaries.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: src/adapters/pi/tools/session-handoff.ts no longer sets editor text or displays command hints; tool output reports action/reason/next_safe_action only and details set user_command_surfaced=false. tests/smoke/session-handoff.test.mjs asserts no command is returned from tool-context new-session/context-refresh paths.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: Where Pi/adapter APIs can execute a boundary automatically, CodeWiki does so from agent-owned control flow and restarts from CodeWiki refs.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: src/application/tools/session-handoff.ts executes context-refresh/context-reset through ctx.compact from tool context, marks the boundary completed, and records zero user interrupts/manual commands. Existing command-context /wiki-session-handoff still performs ctx.newSession when command context exists.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: Where host APIs cannot execute a boundary from tool context, CodeWiki records an explicit platform limitation/fallback with next safe action instead of asking the user to press Enter as a routine step.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: src/application/tools/session-handoff.ts returns action=platform-limited for tool-context new-session with next_safe_action, workflow_efficiency.platform_limited_steps, and no command. Smoke tests assert no press-Enter language and platform-limited proof.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: Workflow-efficiency evidence records user-interrupt/manual-command impact for the session-boundary path and keeps validation/task-close/publication proof gates intact.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: Tool result now carries workflow_efficiency {user_interrupts, manual_command_count, session_boundaries_used, platform_limited_steps}; no validation/task-close/publication logic was changed. KB/skill/tool catalog docs explain efficiency evidence and non-goal preservation.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: Focused smoke tests cover automatic/no-user-command behavior and unsupported fallback semantics.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: tests/smoke/session-handoff.test.mjs covers platform-limited new-session, automatic context-refresh compaction, no follow-up command queuing, command-context compatibility execution, failure status, and malformed boundary handling. package-smoke and claim-wait queue tests pass unchanged.

closure_brief.user_intent: Make session/context boundary creation agent-owned and prioritize workflow efficiency before decision_build work.
implemented_changes: Added automatic tool-context context_refresh/context_reset compaction with zero manual-command evidence.
Changed tool-context new_session to explicit platform-limited fallback with next safe action, no slash command queuing, and no editor prefill.
Added workflow_efficiency evidence to session-boundary results.
Updated Pi adapter prompt/schema output so /wiki-session-handoff is not normal user workflow.
Updated CodeWiki KB/skill/tool catalog wording to match implemented behavior.
acceptance_evidence: tests/smoke/session-handoff.test.mjs asserts platform-limited new-session fallback, automatic context-refresh compaction, no command surface, and workflow_efficiency evidence.
npm run typecheck, npm run check:architecture, npm run test:smoke, and npm test passed.
CodeWiki audit passed stale-reference/generated-parity/file-structure/task; alignment warning only existing large compilers doc graph-health warning and changed warning generated graph state.
non_goals_preserved: Did not implement full decision_build compiler.
Did not weaken validation/task-close/publication proof gates.
Did not promise true terminal tab/process creation in Pi.
Did not remove internal /wiki-session-handoff compatibility command.
remaining_risks: Tool-context new_session still needs future adapter command-context/external-orchestrator support for full automation; current behavior records platform limitation instead of user-command work.

risks: Tool-context new-session remains platform-limited in Pi until an adapter command-context or external-orchestrator path exists; this is now explicit evidence instead of user work.
